name: capped_margin_program_year_n_oi_increase
question_template: Current revenue is {REVENUE_BN} USD billion. Cost of goods sold is {COGS_PCT} percent of revenue and operating expenses are {OPEX_PCT} percent of revenue; operating income is revenue minus both, and operating margin is operating income over revenue. A program lifts the margin by {IMPROVE_BP} basis points above the current margin. Mode {MODE}: 'once' applies the full gain from year 1 and holds it flat; 'each_year' adds another {IMPROVE_BP} basis points every year, so year t carries t times that gain. The cumulative gain in any year is capped at {CAP_BP} basis points. Revenue grows {GROWTH_PCT} percent per year compounded with year 1 one growth step after the current year. Report in USD millions the increase in year {YEARS} operating income over current operating income, not the multi-year cumulative gain.

slots.description: Current-year operating income in USD millions
Capped cumulative margin gain applied in the final year, basis points
Operating margin in the final year, in percent
Total operating income summed over years one through the final year, USD millions

program:
def solve():
    rev_bn = Fraction(P["REVENUE_BN"])
    cogs_pct = Fraction(P["COGS_PCT"])
    opex_pct = Fraction(P["OPEX_PCT"])
    improve_bp = Fraction(P["IMPROVE_BP"])
    mode = P["MODE"]
    cap_bp = Fraction(P["CAP_BP"])
    growth = Fraction(P["GROWTH_PCT"]) / 100
    years = int(P["YEARS"])
    if mode not in ("once", "each_year"):
        raise ValueError("unknown mode")
    if years < 1:
        raise ValueError("years must be at least 1")
    rev0 = rev_bn * 1000  # USD millions
    margin0 = 100 - cogs_pct - opex_pct  # percent
    oi0 = rev0 * margin0 / 100
    cumulative = Fraction(0)
    oi_t = oi0
    margin_t = margin0
    gain_t = Fraction(0)
    for t in range(1, years + 1):
        rev_t = rev0 * (1 + growth) ** t
        raw_gain = improve_bp if mode == "once" else improve_bp * t
        gain_t = min(raw_gain, cap_bp)
        margin_t = margin0 + gain_t / 100
        oi_t = rev_t * margin_t / 100
        cumulative += oi_t
    final = oi_t - oi0
    return {
        "final": final,
        "current_operating_income": oi0,
        "final_year_gain_bp": gain_t,
        "final_year_margin_pct": margin_t,
        "cumulative_operating_income": cumulative,
    }
